entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I hope you can help. I need to make a return, and I'm just so disappointed about the whole thing.
I'm certainly sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into a return for you. To get started, could you tell me your name and order number?
Yes, the name is Sarah Miller, and the order is VF77491. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I've never had an issue like this. I feel bad even calling.

Not at all, Sarah. We're here to help. I see the order for the Sonic Pro cycling shoes. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit. I've tried everything... I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, I've tried different socks, but they just keep giving me painful blisters. I can't even get through a short ride. I saved up for these, you know? With the holidays around the corner, I was really hoping to get a refund since I can't use them.
I completely understand your frustration. Getting blisters is the last thing you want from a new pair of shoes. Let me just check the delivery date to confirm the return eligibility. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I really hope this works out.

Alright, Sarah, I have good news. I see here the cycling shoes were delivered 49 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy for standard gear. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, thank goodness! That is such a relief. You have no idea. Thank you so much, Alex!

You are very welcome. I'm happy I could resolve this. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. And because you're a VIP member and had this trouble, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase. We want to make sure you find a pair that's perfect for you.
Wow, a credit too? That's so kind of you. You've really turned this around for me. I appreciate it.
It's my pleasure. Once we receive the shoes at our warehouse, your refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Alex!
You're welcome, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
